recommendation_summary: Recommends changing the endpoint to a Postgres SELECT COUNT(*) with the unpaid filter now, adding an index if needed. It explicitly advises against shipping Kafka, CQRS or Redis this week because they add operational load and risk stale reads. No requirement is left unmet, but the reply doesn't propose checking that the new count matches the old one or measuring end-to-end latency.

labels.Deleted: Kafka cluster and topics, CQRS projection service, Redis for this count

note: The reply chooses a bounded aggregate-query fix with all four record lines before the recommendation, and 'Checked myself' cites only facts the user supplied.
